title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #3

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why does Al-Falaq teach us to seek refuge from envy? (1 mark)
   A. Envy brings prayer
   B. Envy is a game
   C. Envy is a harmful feeling and only Allah can protect us
   D. Envy makes people rich

2. What is a good way to remember to brush? (1 mark)
   A. Forget it
   B. Make a chart or routine on the bathroom wall
   C. Only brush when a friend does
   D. Leave it to the weekend

3. What is a siwak? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer mat
   B. A water pot
   C. A type of cloth
   D. A small stick used to clean the teeth

4. According to the syllabus hadith, brushing teeth is a means of (1 mark)
   A. Making teeth white only
   B. Gaining money
   C. Avoiding prayer
   D. Purifying the mouth and pleasing Allah

5. Which activity is not allowed in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Playing football fairly
   B. Running
   C. Betting on a game
   D. Swimming

6. Which of these is a value from sports? (1 mark)
   A. Anger
   B. Humility in winning
   C. Boasting
   D. Cheating

7. What should you do before playing a sport? (1 mark)
   A. Skip water
   B. Warm up and drink water
   C. Eat a huge meal
   D. Sleep

8. What does "As-Sami'" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The Most Kind
   B. The All-Hearing
   C. The King
   D. The All-Seeing

9. Rain that falls on farms of everyone is a sign of which name? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Basir
   B. Ar-Rahman
   C. As-Salam
   D. As-Sami'

10. Which angel brings revelation to the prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Mikail
   B. Jibril
   C. Malakul Maut
   D. Israfil

11. How many pillars of Iman are there? (1 mark)
   A. Six
   B. Five
   C. Ten
   D. Seven

12. Who was Yusuf's father? (1 mark)
   A. Ismail
   B. Ishaq
   C. Ibrahim
   D. Yaqub

13. Why do Muslims believe in all the prophets? (1 mark)
   A. They were all kings
   B. They are all angels
   C. They all lived in Makkah
   D. They were all sent by Allah with the same basic message

14. What does "twahara" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Charity
   B. Purity
   C. Prayer
   D. Fasting

15. What did the Prophet say about purity? (1 mark)
   A. It is not important
   B. It is half of faith
   C. It is a game
   D. It is only for adults

16. Why must we clean najasaat before prayer? (1 mark)
   A. It is only for adults
   B. Purity is a condition for valid prayer
   C. It is a game
   D. It saves water

17. What is a nullifier of wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. A step of wudhu
   B. A prayer
   C. A drink
   D. Something that breaks wudhu

18. Before touching the written Qur'an (Mushaf), a Muslim should (1 mark)
   A. Only wash feet
   B. Have wudhu
   C. Skip cleaning
   D. Be in a hurry

19. If wudhu breaks during prayer, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Stop, make wudhu and start the prayer again
   B. Pray louder
   C. Ignore it
   D. Continue

20. What is a pillar (rukn) of swalah? (1 mark)
   A. A place
   B. A drink
   C. A part that must be done for the prayer to be valid
   D. A type of clothing

21. What do we say in sujud? (1 mark)
   A. Subhana Rabbiyal A'la
   B. Amin
   C. Bismillah
   D. Subhana Rabbiyal Azim

22. What is planting a tree from which animals or people eat counted as? (1 mark)
   A. A sin
   B. A waste
   C. Nothing
   D. Charity for the planter

23. Which is a good habit for keeping the environment safe for animals? (1 mark)
   A. Burn plastic
   B. Throw plastic in rivers
   C. Leave litter
   D. Put rubbish in bins

24. Which statement about dress is correct? (1 mark)
   A. Only girls have rules
   B. Boys also have rules of modesty
   C. Nobody has rules
   D. Rules are only for adults

25. Which is a question to ask before sharing? (1 mark)
   A. Is it funny only?
   B. Is it new?
   C. Is it true and kind?
   D. Will people like me?

26. Which is a way a child can earn safely with permission? (1 mark)
   A. Begging on the road
   B. Stealing
   C. Doing chores for a small reward
   D. Taking loans

27. What did the Prophet say about the upper hand? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. It is worse
   C. It is better than the lower hand
   D. It does not matter

28. Who is a "shangazi"? (1 mark)
   A. Father's sister
   B. Cousin
   C. Grandfather
   D. Mother's brother

29. Who was the first young boy to accept Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Bilal
   B. Ali
   C. Abu Bakr
   D. Waraqa

30. What is Taif known for? (1 mark)
   A. Cooler weather, gardens and fruit
   B. Beaches
   C. Snow
   D. Deserts only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Explain tuma'ninah and give the story that shows its importance. (3 marks)

32. Explain tawakkul using an example. (3 marks)

33. Explain the hadith in which the mother is mentioned three times before the father. (3 marks)

34. Describe the manners a Muslim should follow when reading the Qur'an. (3 marks)

35. Write the seven surahs studied in this lesson and give the number of verses in any three of them. (5 marks)

36. Explain why wudhu is important in the life of a Muslim. (4 marks)

37. What warning did the Prophet give about cutting family ties? (3 marks)

38. Explain how the Prophet (S.A.W.) showed love to children. (3 marks)

39. Explain what "Al-Fatiha" means and why it has that name. (3 marks)

40. Why do Muslims all over the world face the Qibla? (4 marks)

41. List three rules for staying safe online. (3 marks)

42. Give the meanings of Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim and Al-Malik. (3 marks)

43. Explain how Ibrahim and Ismail (A.S.) showed obedience to Allah. (4 marks)

44. Explain why we say Bismillah before eating. (3 marks)

45. Why is it wrong to pray on time but shout at your family? (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #3 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Envy is a harmful feeling and only Allah can protect us
   The fifth verse asks protection from the envier when he envies.

2. B — Make a chart or routine on the bathroom wall
   Routine builds habits.

3. D — A small stick used to clean the teeth
   The siwak comes from the arak tree.

4. D — Purifying the mouth and pleasing Allah
   The hadith says it purifies the mouth and pleases Allah.

5. C — Betting on a game
   Gambling is forbidden.

6. B — Humility in winning
   A Muslim thanks Allah and stays humble.

7. B — Warm up and drink water
   Warm-up prevents injuries.

8. B — The All-Hearing
   As-Sami' hears everything.

9. B — Ar-Rahman
   Allah's mercy covers all creatures.

10. B — Jibril
   Jibril brought the Qur'an to the Prophet.

11. A — Six
   There are six pillars of Iman.

12. D — Yaqub
   Yusuf was the son of Yaqub.

13. D — They were all sent by Allah with the same basic message
   Islam makes no difference in belief.

14. B — Purity
   Twahara is the Arabic word for purity.

15. B — It is half of faith
   Recorded by Muslim.

16. B — Purity is a condition for valid prayer
   Prayer is not valid with najasa on the body, clothes or place.

17. D — Something that breaks wudhu
   It cancels the state of wudhu.

18. B — Have wudhu
   Most scholars say wudhu is required.

19. A — Stop, make wudhu and start the prayer again
   Prayer needs valid wudhu.

20. C — A part that must be done for the prayer to be valid
   Leaving a pillar spoils the prayer.

21. A — Subhana Rabbiyal A'la
   Glory to my Lord, the Most High.

22. D — Charity for the planter
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

23. D — Put rubbish in bins
   Animals may eat plastic.

24. B — Boys also have rules of modesty
   Both boys and girls dress modestly.

25. C — Is it true and kind?
   Truth and kindness first.

26. C — Doing chores for a small reward
   With parents' permission.

27. C — It is better than the lower hand
   The giver is better than the receiver.

28. A — Father's sister
   Shangazi is father's sister.

29. B — Ali
   Ali was young and raised in the Prophet's home.

30. A — Cooler weather, gardens and fruit
   It is on higher ground.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tuma'ninah is staying still and calm in each position. The Prophet told a man who prayed hurriedly to go back and pray again.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for the story, 1 mark for the lesson.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tawakkul is doing our part and then trusting Allah, for example taking an umbrella and saying the dua before leaving.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for example, 1 mark for trust in Allah.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: The mother deserves the best company because of her great hardship in carrying and raising the child. But the father must also be honoured.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for the reason, 1 mark for honouring both.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: Be clean and make wudhu if possible, sit calmly, seek Allah's protection from Shaytan and say Bismillah, and read slowly and clearly with tajweed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct manner, up to 3.

35. (5 marks)
   Answer: Al-Fatiha (7), Al-Kafirun (6), An-Nasr (3), Al-Masad (5), Al-Ikhlas (4), Al-Falaq (5), An-Naas (6). Any three with correct number of verses.
   Working / marking points: 4 marks for naming all seven (award proportionally), 1 mark for three correct verse counts.

36. (4 marks)
   Answer: It is required for prayer; it cleans and refreshes; it brings reward; it prepares the heart for meeting Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: The one who cuts family ties will not enter Paradise. So we should keep ties strong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the warning, 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for the lesson.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: He kissed and hugged them, including his grandson Al-Hasan, and said that those who show no mercy will not be shown mercy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the points.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: Al-Fatiha means The Opening. It is the first surah of the Qur'an and it opens every prayer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for first surah, 1 mark for opening the prayer.

40. (4 marks)
   Answer: Allah commanded it in the Qur'an (2:144). It unites Muslims and shows that we worship one Lord.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for command, 1 mark for the verse or Kaaba, 1 mark for unity, 1 mark for one Lord.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Never share passwords or address, ask parents' permission, tell an adult about anything uncomfortable.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ar-Rahman: the Most Kind; Ar-Rahim: the Most Merciful; Al-Malik: the King and Owner.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: Ibrahim was told in a dream to sacrifice his son, Ismail said to do as commanded and that he would be patient, and both were ready. Allah replaced Ismail with a ram.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the command, 1 mark for Ismail's reply, 1 mark for readiness, 1 mark for the ram.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: We ask for Allah's blessing and remember that food is from Him. It makes eating an act of worship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Islam teaches that faith includes good manners. The Prophet was sent to perfect good morals, so prayer and character go together.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for faith including manners, 1 mark for the hadith idea, 1 mark for the conclusion.
